2.name: TEXT_HOUFIXCOMPANYSUBMARINE_00447_SUBMARINE_SELECT_TITLE
2.translation_description: Sommergibili schierati: <hex:022003E80303>/<hex:022003E80403><hex:02100103>Serbatoi di ceruleo: <hex:022003E80203><hex:02100103>Scegli un sommergibile.

3.name: TEXT_HOUFIXCOMPANYSUBMARINE_00447_ADD_NEW_SUBMARINE
3.description: Outfit and register a submersible. (Dive credits required: <hex:022003E80203>)
3.translation_description: Equipaggia e registra un sommergibile. (Permessi d'immersione richiesti: <hex:022003E80203>)

8.name: TEXT_HOUFIXCOMPANYSUBMARINE_00447_SUBMARINE_CMD_EXPEDITION
8.translation_description: Invia il sommergibile in un viaggio sottomarino

22.name: TEXT_HOUFIXCOMPANYSUBMARINE_00447_SUBMARINE_NAME_MES_0
22.description: Names must be formed from alphanumeric characters. The following punctuation marks are also allowed:<hex:02100103><hex:024804F201FC03><hex:024904F201FD03>'<hex:021D0103>. , : ; ! ? & - _<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103><hex:02100103>• Double spaces/underscores are not allowed.<hex:02100103>• A space cannot be used before or after the name.<hex:02100103>• Names consisting solely of punctuation marks are prohibited.
22.translation_description: I nomi devono essere composti da caratteri alfanumerici. Sono ammessi anche i seguenti segni di punteggiatura:<hex:02100103><hex:024804F201FC03><hex:024904F201FD03>'<hex:021D0103>. , : ; ! ? & - _<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103><hex:02100103>• Non sono ammessi doppi spazi o doppi trattini bassi.<hex:02100103>• Il nome non può iniziare o terminare con uno spazio.<hex:02100103>• Non sono ammessi nomi composti solo da segni di punteggiatura.

23.name: TEXT_HOUFIXCOMPANYSUBMARINE_00447_REMOVE_SUBMARINE_TITLE
23.description: Are you certain you wish to dismantle <hex:021A020203><hex:022903EA0203><hex:021A020103>?<hex:02100103><hex:024804F201FC03><hex:024904F201FD03>Please note that while submersible components will be returned, your submersible's registration, rank, and accrued experience will be lost.<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>
23.translation_description: Vuoi davvero smantellare <hex:021A020203><hex:022903EA0203><hex:021A020103>?<hex:02100103><hex:024804F201FC03><hex:024904F201FD03>Nota: riceverai indietro i componenti del sommergibile, ma perderai la registrazione, il grado e l'esperienza accumulata.<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>

25.name: TEXT_HOUFIXCOMPANYSUBMARINE_00447_NO_REGISTRATION_1
25.description: To outfit and register a submersible, you must have in your possession the requisite components and dive credits.
25.translation_description: Per equipaggiare e registrare un sommergibile, devi possedere i componenti necessari e i permessi d'immersione.

26.name: TEXT_HOUFIXCOMPANYSUBMARINE_00447_NO_REGISTRATION_2
26.description: <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Dive credits<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> can be purchased from resident caretakers with company credits.
26.translation_description: I <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>permessi d'immersione<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> si acquistano dai custodi residenziali con i crediti della Compagnia.

27.name: TEXT_HOUFIXCOMPANYSUBMARINE_00447_NO_REGISTRATION_3
27.description: <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Submersible components<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> can be constructed in your company workshop. Please note that hull, stern, bow, and bridge components are required to outfit a submersible.
27.translation_description: I <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>componenti del sommergibile<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> si costruiscono nell’officina della Compagnia. Per equipaggiare un sommergibile sono necessari lo scafo, la poppa, la prua e la plancia.

28.name: TEXT_HOUFIXCOMPANYSUBMARINE_00447_NO_ENERGY
28.description: You cannot deploy your submersible on subaquatic voyages without ceruleum tanks, which can be purchased from resident caretakers with company credits.
28.translation_description: Non puoi inviare il sommergibile in un viaggio sottomarino senza serbatoi di ceruleo, che puoi acquistare dai custodi residenziali con i crediti della Compagnia.

29.name: TEXT_HOUFIXCOMPANYSUBMARINE_00447_NO_EXPLOG_1
29.description: Upon the completion of a subaquatic voyage, your mammet will provide a <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>voyage log<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> detailing the results.
29.translation_description: Al termine di un viaggio sottomarino, il mammet ti consegnerà un <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>registro di bordo<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> con i risultati.

30.name: TEXT_HOUFIXCOMPANYSUBMARINE_00447_NO_EXPLOG_2
30.description: The information contained in this log may prove useful in preparing for your next subaquatic voyage.
30.translation_description: Le informazioni contenute nel registro possono tornare utili per preparare il prossimo viaggio sottomarino.

31.name: TEXT_HOUFIXCOMPANYSUBMARINE_00447_NO_EXPLOG_3
31.description: Please note that only the log for the previous voyage will be retained.
31.translation_description: Viene conservato solo il registro del viaggio precedente.

32.name: TEXT_HOUFIXCOMPANYSUBMARINE_00447_NO_REPAIR_ITEM
32.description: You cannot repair submersible components without the requisite materials.
32.translation_description: Non puoi riparare i componenti del sommergibile senza i materiali necessari.
